overloads.semanticRole: The METHOD OPEN PATH command opens, in the 4D Method editor, the method whose internal pathname is passed in the path parameter.

constraints: The method must already exist; if path does not correspond to an existing method, error -9801 ("Cannot open method") is generated.
When called from a component, the * parameter is mandatory (component code is read-only); omitting it in that context generates error -9763.
The command is asynchronous: it returns immediately without waiting for the Method editor to finish opening.
